limits: Independent source, support and metric checks. These checks do not establish calibrated probabilities, an alert policy, production performance or final-test acceptance.

null_and_support_rules.class_support: Positive, negative and mixed-label distinct trips are retained, alongside snapshot counts.
null_and_support_rules.empty_reliability_bin: Zero weight; mean probability and observed event rate are null.
null_and_support_rules.incomplete_fixed_cohort: All probability metrics are null; incomplete support is explicit.
null_and_support_rules.ranking: Both ROC AUC and noninterpolated AP null for one-class/no-scored-label groups; probability losses retained when a scored label exists.
null_and_support_rules.sparse_groups: Fewer than 20 scored distinct tenant/trips is flagged; valid probability losses are retained.
null_and_support_rules.unscored_outcomes: Unknown, pending, incomplete, cancelled and already-arrived outcomes do not become negative labels.

probability_metric_checks.reference_method: scikit-learn weighted probability metrics; pandas trip and fixed-bin grouping; no repository scorer imports

scope: Original-training-period forward-fold raw delay probabilities; no calibration or alert-threshold selection.

source_and_target_checks.reference_method: Independent sqlite as-of source joins, explicit trip and availability gates; no ds_m01 imports.

training_support_and_prevalence_checks.reference_method: Binary prior computed as exact rational per-trip mean; new deadline scaling from source clocks using 50-digit Decimal moments; model support and fitted groups compared independently.
